show_link.info: The delivery list already shows this row. Turn on when the product page has no delivery list.

audience.info: Wholesale buyers use the wholesale quantity block or the order matrix.

show_accelerated.info: Shop Pay and other express payment methods set up in your store's payment settings.

heading.info: For example Complete the look, Complete the routine or Complete the ritual.

pick_complementary_products_in_the_searc.content: Pick complementary products in the Search & Discovery app.

fit_text.info: Connect a metafield such as a fit guide. The row is hidden when empty.

shipping_rules_installments_and_the_retu.content: Shipping rules, installments and the returns text are in Theme settings > Delivery information and Installments.

show_notify.info: Opens the back-in-stock drawer when the product has one.

clamp_chars.info: 0 shows the full description. Longer texts get a See more link.

heading.info: Leave empty for "Description" in the shopper's language.

color_scheme.info: Leave as the section scheme or pick one for a panel.

tag.info: Automatic uses H1 for the first section of a page and H2 elsewhere.

shown_to_wholesale_buyers_when_theme_set.content: Shown to wholesale buyers when Theme settings > Wholesale allows it and Theme settings > Installments has a provider name. Uses the minimum order for the amount.

shown_to_wholesale_buyers_on_products_wi.content: Shown to wholesale buyers on products with the order matrix tag (Theme settings > Wholesale). Rows use the first option; columns use the other options.

image.info: Connect a product metafield to show a different chart per product.

label.info: For example Size guide, Shade guide or How to choose. Leave empty for the default.

options.picker: Next to the matching option in the variant picker

sale_sold_out_new_pre_order_and_custom_l.content: Sale, sold out, new, pre-order and custom labels follow the selected variant. Edit them in Theme settings > Product labels.

show_installments.info: Appears when Shop Pay Installments is available for the store.

rating_value.info: Connect a rating metafield. Leave empty to use the product's own rating (reviews.rating).

heading.info: Leave empty for the default. Shown only for products with subscriptions or other selling plans.

link.info: Makes the whole slide a link. Buttons keep their own links.

in_stock_extra.info: For example your dispatch time. Only shown for items in stock.

guide_option.info: Option names separated by commas. Needs a Product guide block.

shows_the_selected_variant_s_volume_pric.content: Shows the selected variant's volume pricing from your B2B catalog. Hidden when a product has no price breaks. Rows before "Show all" are set in Theme settings > Wholesale.

buy_box_for_wholesale_buyers_on_products.content: Buy box for wholesale buyers on products without the order matrix. Follows each variant's quantity rule and volume pricing.

minimum_pack_size_and_maximum_from_your_.content: Minimum, pack size and maximum from your B2B quantity rules. Shown only to wholesale buyers; default rules show nothing.

shipping_calculator_default_country.info: Two-letter code. Leave empty to use the visitor's country.

use_product_image.label: Use the first product's image when the collection has none

turn_compare_on_and_choose_its_rows_in_t.content: Turn compare on and choose its rows in Theme settings > Product compare.

custom_liquid.info: Add app snippets or other code. Code here isn't checked by the theme.

link_images.info: Collection images, or the first product image when a collection has none.

menu_item.info: Title of the top-level menu item that opens this mega menu.

shown_to_wholesale_buyers_whose_company_.content: Shown to wholesale buyers whose company has two or more locations.

show_wholesale_line.info: Helps wholesale buyers following an old link to a trade-only product.

shipping_default_country.info: Country name as it appears in the list, for example "Spain". Uses the shopper's country when empty.

terms_page.info: When set, shoppers tick a box to accept the terms before checkout.

filters_open_lg.info: When off, filters open in a drawer on every screen size.

group_media_by_option.info: Each variant's featured image starts its group. Put the images for each value together, in variant order.
group_media_by_option.label: Show only the media for the selected option value

sticky_bar_mobile.info: Shows the selected options and Add to cart when the main button scrolls out of view. Hidden for wholesale buyers.

products_only.info: When off, pages and blog posts appear after products.

recommendations_are_based_on_sales_and_p.content: Recommendations are based on sales and product descriptions. Adjust them in the Search & Discovery app.

wholesale_buyers_order_several_products_.content: Wholesale buyers order several products from one list. Each variant follows its own quantity rule, stock and volume pricing. Retail visitors see a sign-in prompt.

video.info: Background videos play automatically only when uploaded to Shopify.

apply_page.info: Uses the page from Theme settings > Wholesale when empty.

attention_messages.info: Shown in the browser tab title while visitors look at another tab.

reveal_on_scroll.info: Always off for visitors who ask for reduced motion.

cart_free_shipping_rules.info: One line per currency, for example "EUR: 69". The bar only shows for currencies you list.

accents.info: Status colors are always shown together with a text label.

currency_code_enable.info: Useful when you sell in several currencies with the same symbol.

code_runs_on_every_page_marketing_code_w.content: Code runs on every page. Marketing code waits for consent through Shopify's customer privacy settings.

delivery_default_rule.info: Example: "54.95". Leave empty to hide the shipping row for unlisted countries.

delivery_round_up.info: Keeps converted amounts at or above what checkout charges.

delivery_rules.info: One line per zone: countries = rate / free from, with an optional currency. Example: "ES, AD = 4.95 / 69". Leave "free from" empty when there is no free shipping. Amounts use your store currency unless the line starts with a currency code, for example "GB = GBP 4.95 / 99".

rules_for_the_delivery_list_on_product_p.content: Rules for the delivery list on product pages. No delivery date is ever shown.

installments_countries.info: Two-letter country codes separated by commas. Leave empty for all countries.

the_installments_row_on_product_pages_sh.content: The installments row on product pages. Shopify Payments installments show separately when available.

card_subtitle_metafield.info: Namespace and key of a single-line text metafield.

highlighted_products.info: Collection sections can highlight products with a tag.

compare_metafields.info: One per line: Label = namespace.key, for example "Material = custom.material".

stock_low_threshold.info: Retail shoppers see "Only a few left" at or below this number. Exact counts are never shown to retail shoppers unless you choose so below.

stock_wholesale_low_threshold.info: Wholesale buyers see exact counts; at or below this number the count is marked as low.

label_custom_metafield.info: Namespace and key of a single-line text metafield. Its text becomes the label.

voice_search_enable.info: Shows a microphone button in browsers that support speech recognition.

chat_button.info: A floating button that opens WhatsApp with the page link filled in.

links_show_in_the_footer_and_on_the_pass.content: Links show in the footer and on the password page.

social_whatsapp_url.info: A wa.me link, for example https://wa.me/34600000000. Also used by the chat button.

swatch_color_list.info: Used when Shopify has no swatch for a value. One per line, for example "Ecru: #E6DCC6".

swatch_option_names.info: Separate names with commas. Options with these names show swatches.

navigation_font_source.info: Uses one of the two fonts above, so pages load no extra font file.

wholesale_assorted_packs.info: For products sold as assorted packs: one-size lines show every color value.

wholesale_installments.info: Only turn this on when your B2B checkout offers the installments provider.

wholesale_matrix_tag.info: Products with this tag show the color × size order matrix to wholesale buyers.

wholesale_mode_is_on_for_customers_signe.content: Wholesale mode is on for customers signed in to a Shopify B2B company location. Prices, quantity rules and volume pricing always come from your B2B catalogs.

wholesale_only_tag.info: Fallback for products that are still visible to retail. Prefer excluding them from your retail catalogs.

wholesale_pack_image_metafield.info: Product metafield with an image that replaces the line image for wholesale buyers.

wholesale_quick_order_drawer.info: Wholesale buyers open the order matrix or quantity box from a card without leaving the collection.
